verdict.rationale: Airweave documents syncing data from connected apps and databases into collections and searching them with vector or agentic search. The evidence never shows a capability to add memories from conversations so that context persists across sessions. Vector search over synced sources, and the option to build a custom connector, are adjacent features and developer building blocks rather than a conversational memory-write capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add memories from conversations and retrieve them later with semantic search, so context persists across sessions
